applications.title: Site Plan for 7422 Springfield Ave. - Residential Addition

fields.description: The applicant is presenting a site plan showing an addition at the rear of the structure in order to accommodate a new studio style apartment below two existing apartments in the same building. All principle permitted uses in the B-L zone, where a building permit and zoning certificate are required, are also subject to a site plan review by the Planning Commission per Town Code §180-95.
